correctness.rationale: Independent reconstruction used all 8 vertex outgoing choices (none or one of 3 neighbors), rejecting repeated oriented edges and directed cycles. It found 23625 faces including the empty face, matching det(tI+L)=t(t+2)^3(t+4)^3(t+6). A new ordinary acyclic toggle matching has 11700 nonempty pairs and exactly one critical 0-, 44 critical 5-, 179 critical 6-cells. The ordinary 124176 nonempty Hasse covers were topologically sorted; augmented poset has another 24 covers. Direct signed gradient-path recursion produced a 44-by-179 matrix with 195 nonzero entries and exact Smith form forty unit factors, no other nonzeros. Hurewicz pi5(wedge^44 S5)=Z^44 implies the 6-cell maps are classified by degrees, and cancelling forty primitive maps yields wedge^4 S5 wedge wedge^139 S6.
